section: Deactivate and Activate / Commit Safety Workflow
content:
# Deactivate and Activate / Commit Safety Workflow

Configuration may be deactivated without deleting it.

Concepts include:

deactivate

activate

This can be useful when temporarily disabling configuration while preserving it.

Always verify version-specific behavior.

---

Recommended workflow:

1. configure
2. Make one logical change.
3. show | compare
4. commit check
5. commit confirmed when lockout risk exists
6. Test
7. Confirm commit
8. Document result

---
